count_analysis.gap_lfg_to_obi: LFG claims 40 commands, obi.ps1 declares 22 — 18 commands undocumented in obi.ps1

verdict.impact: Three sources of truth (LegionnaireFieldGuide.md, .kilo/command/ directory, SCRIPTS/obi.ps1) describe different command sets. LFG claims 40 commands but lists 41 with duplicates. 1 command (rebirthe) is listed but missing. 3 existing docs (SoulSearch, soulaudit, kilo-free-models) are not in LFG. obi.ps1 only declares 22 of the 40. This makes the command surface unknowable without reading all three sources.
required_action: 1. MAKE LegionnaireFieldGuide.md line 35 authoritative: deduplicate, add missing commands, remove extras
2. ADD rebirthe.md to .kilo/command/ OR remove from LFG list
3. ADD SoulSearch.md, soulaudit.md, kilo-free-models.md to LFG list
4. UPDATE obi.ps1 ValidateSet to match LFG canonical list (or shrink LFG to match obi.ps1 — decision required)
5. STANDARDIZE naming: all command docs should use lowercase-with-hyphens to match obi.ps1 pattern
6. ADD validation: obi.ps1 doctor should verify .kilo/command/ matches LFG list
